ShortDescription.Value: Custom city starting budget and milestones, add automatic budget support, and Convert Unlimited Money saves to normal.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Budget + Milestones
Custom City Start progression and budget options. Make it harder or easier to start a new city or maintain a city if you get in deep water.
#### City Start - Choose the starting money balance for the next loaded limited-money city. - Choose a higher milestone to unlock when the next city loads. - Choose if Milestone reward money is disabled or game default amounts. - Milestone rewards use the game's own milestone values and unlock events.
#### Unlimited Money Converter - Convert a city created with Unlimited Money into normal limited-money budgeting. - Make a backup save first. The conversion cannot be undone by the mod.
#### Budget - these tools used to be in City Watchdog mod and spun off to this one. - Add or subtract a selected amount with hotkeys. - Optional Auto add can keep the city above a selected threshold.
No Harmony patch.
